item.text:
Implemented `assetUrl(relativePath)` in `src/asset-url.js`.

- Reads `ASSET_BASE_URL` on every call
- Defaults to `/assets`
- Normalizes trailing and leading slashes
- Returns the normalized base for an empty path
- Verified with runtime assertions and `git diff --check`
